config.selection: validation only: .25 clean NME + .25 augmented NME + .5 OOD NME; normal error must be <= .5px

validation.metric_definition: Euclidean pixel error; NME and PCK thresholds relative to full image diagonal. Absent/out-of-frame points excluded; occluded points included.

test.metric_definition: Euclidean pixel error; NME and PCK thresholds relative to full image diagonal. Absent/out-of-frame points excluded; occluded points included.
